production_contract: Pennel-managed local Decider with exact same loaded-FD artifact hash and genuine runtime/protocol fingerprint; compact independent state/support questions; one official prompt per independent single-question native sequence, at most eight sequences per decode chunk; shared production source decoder.
calibration_role: Diagnostic only. Calibrate every state and support context on the calibration split; runtime uses explicit support/state choices without a fitted threshold.
identity_evidence: serving_revision_and_artifact only. Configured friendly model name never supplies actual identity; actual model is the hashed loaded artifact, revision identifies the verified actual runtime/protocol, artifact SHA is independently checked.

acceptance.hosted_warm_complete_job_p95: within the frozen configured whole-job deadline, never over 90 seconds

items: Independently authored SOURCE0 state and kind-support judgments. Complete-item metrics include original four state components only, exact literal quotes and every frozen central/adjacent source anchor. Unsupported owner/due/prior extraction remains null. Easy support rows cannot inflate item F1.
calibration: Only calibration distributions fit artifacts. Actual authored physical template, slot, batch size, question, label order, provider/model and grouping bind each context. Require actual export coverage across every intended split before inference; commit fitted lock before heldout.
resource_scope: Owned application-client preparation, owned local inference supervisor and native worker and final Rust raw replay. Per-original-job whole_job_elapsed_ms is mandatory. Fixed five fresh-client and thirty warm complete jobs on a frozen development source, plus separately reported maximum512-turn development stress. Actual local model/runtime CPU/RSS belong to the owned process measurements; no remote provider is used. RSS is the maximum individual-process lifetime high-water mark across the isolated client and waited children; individual client/child marks are retained. Aggregate process-tree and native GUI RSS are unmeasured and are not claimed by this manual-route gate.
adoption: Emit a candidate only after unchanged exact-source, original-job, state/item/precision/resource gates and separate raw/calibrated support quality gates pass. Never write the registry or reuse failed A/B quality credit.
support_abstention: Unclear or model-abstained support is a null prediction counted as a missed class/coverage loss, not a third event class. Retain its raw distribution for calibration. State unknown remains a real state.
transport: pennel-local://decider/decisions; exact reserved managed model and expected artifact fingerprint; no HTTP/key/account/Cloud fallback. Local-only independent-window batch envelope, independent-single-question-v1 native execution and compact question definitions are frozen before held-out inference.
